title: KP14 bounded exposure (cap 2.5), mirrored types \pm0.3 / 0.7 / 1.2, level ladder 0.5..2.0, \gamma_v 4.0
question: Does a KP14 economy whose only type-dependence is a PRODUCT of two visible mean-zero factors (sign of b via size, eps - 1 via ROE) reach a fair gap of 0.1/yr (+0.029 monthly)?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-31). The KP14 interaction slot: vyge/vygel (positive b) had room 10-27% because b_f (eps-1) is monotone in ROE; vygesm (mirrored, |b| <= 0.15) 7-12% because the positivity bound made the product's Sharpe tiny; vygels (mirrored to 0.45) could not be solved (negative unit project values). vygelbw with the bound raised from 2 to 2.5: the slope at y = 0 is unchanged, the claim's swing over the y range is larger. Cap 3 turns unit values negative (-0.16); 2.5 keeps them positive (min +0.24).

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-10-31): oracle room 40% or more (both factors mean zero, as in vyg25s / bvychs30) and a fair gap of +0.03 to +0.10 monthly; passes at +0.029 or more on most seeds. FALSIFIED if room is at or below vygel's 27% on three seeds.
